welcome.headline: Promo Preflight
welcome.positioning: Pre-launch checks for regulated promo campaigns
welcome.body: Load a campaign bundle, run the check, review blockers, assign owners, prepare a handoff summary, and compare versions without changing the existing workflow.
welcome.workflowSubtitle: From loading a campaign bundle to comparing versions

workflowPreview.label: Load the campaign bundle
workflowPreview.description: Metadata, offer math, T&C text, and channel copy

workflowPreview.label: Review blockers
workflowPreview.description: Risk Report shows what blocks launch and who needs to act

workflowPreview.label: Prepare the handoff summary
workflowPreview.description: Copy a short summary for Markdown or Slack

workflowPreview.label: Compare versions
workflowPreview.description: See what changed between campaign versions

steps.title: Start with active campaigns
steps.description: The workspace lists every saved campaign check with its status, open issues, and the owner responsible for the next step.

steps.title: Load a campaign bundle
steps.description: All campaign facts in one place: metadata, offer math, terms, channel assets, links, and launch owners.

steps.title: Run the preflight check
steps.description: One click runs eight checks across the campaign and maps every finding against the rule set before launch.

steps.title: Review what blocks launch
steps.description: The Risk Report ranks issues by severity so the team sees blockers, warnings, and clean checks at a glance.

steps.title: Turn findings into action
steps.description: Each issue shows the affected field, evidence, suggested fix, and the owner who should resolve it.

steps.title: Check launch readiness
steps.description: The readiness board collects blockers and owner sign-offs into one go/no-go decision before handoff.

steps.title: Keep the process repeatable
steps.description: Twenty-three rules backed by eight checks make the workflow auditable: see what was checked, who owns it, and what changed between runs.
